text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
—The moment has finally arrived!! It's 
time for our TV special, "The Spicy King"!

text_block_list.name: Fired-Up Contestant
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOO! The one who becomes the Spicy 
King is gonna be ME~~!!

text_block_list.name: Hyped-Up Contestant
text_block_list.text:
Behold... the fruits of my 1,000 chili 
pepper drills!! CAPSAICIN POWER!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: H-Hawawawa... Awawawawawa...

Meisho Doto had secured an appearance on 
TV— only to find a set thick with bizarre, 
electrifying tension!

It all began with a scout at a Chinese 
restaurant. Her unfazed consumption of 
super-spicy dishes had caught the eye of a 
TV producer.

text_block_list.name: Rookie Producer
text_block_list.text: Ghk, Meisho Doto-san~~!!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Producer
text_block_list.text:
I'm still a rookie at the station... and 
"The Spicy King" is my hard-won big break! 
I absolutely have to make it a success!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Producer
text_block_list.text:
Please! Won't you appear on the show?! 
Lend us your super-spicy power~~!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's looking all prickly-prickly... 
Fight on, Doto-cha~n!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
—Lined up before you on the tables are 
numerous devilishly spicy dishes! The 
contestant who finishes them with the most 
exhilarating gusto will claim the title of 
"Spicy King"!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Now then, take up your chopsticks—and 
START~~!!

text_block_list.name: Contestants
text_block_list.text:
"UOOOH!! I'M GONNA DEVOUR IT ALL~~!!" 
"HAAA! THIS IS THE RESULT OF MY 
TRAINING~~!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hawa... Waaah~~?! S-Such momentum... and 
the heat... is intense...!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Everyone is shoveling it in, refusing to 
be beaten by the spice~! —Oh, we already 
have a contestant clearing their first 
plate!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Uuu...gh. As I thought... on a stage like 
this, someone like me...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Huh-wuh~? What's wrong~? Doto-chan, does 
your tummy hurt~?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehh~?! W-What should we do~! Can I share 
some of Urara's energy with her~?

Was this task simply too daunting for 
someone as timid as her...? Just as that 
thought crossed my mind, the rookie 
producer rushed to the side of the stage!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Producer
text_block_list.text: Doto-san... Doto-san!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Producer
text_block_list.text:
Just as the other contestants are main 
stars— You're a main star too, Doto-san!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Producer
text_block_list.text:
The staff and I... we're waiting for 
"you"! We want to film "you"!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: —Gasp!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
T-That's... right... Even for someone like 
me, someone is placing their hopes on 
me...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Even back at the zoo... my enka... brought 
joy to everyone...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Today too... I must gather my courage...!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: W-Wah-wah-wah!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'm!! Eating!! I'm going to eat it all, 
okay~~?!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa-oh~?! Doto-san is suddenly picking 
up the pace! Is a fierce comeback 
underway~~?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
H-H-Here I go~~?! F-From h-here... is 
where it gets real~~~?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Wah! Amazing, amazing~!! The food is just 
vanishing right into her mouth~!!

text_block_list.name: Hyped-Up Contestant
text_block_list.text:
...W-What insane eating speed! Even after 
training on mountains of habaneros, I 
can't hold a candle to her!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case—I, the incarnation of 
the Ghost Pepper~!! W-Won't l-lose at 
all~~~~!

Continuing to devour everything at a 
smooth pace, Meisho Doto conquered the 
spicy showdown. Thanks to her stellar 
performance, the recording was an 
overwhelming success.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I am! The Spicy King~~!
(Clap clap clap clap!)

text_block_list.name: Rookie Producer
text_block_list.text:
U... Uooooh~! That was the absolute best 
footage, Doto-san~~!!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Producer
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much! It was a massive 
success, Meisho Doto-san!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Producer
text_block_list.text:
Actually, my boss contacted me just now... 
—He said, "I'm putting you in charge of 
the next show too"!! Doto-san, you're the 
savior of my life~~!!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Producer
text_block_list.text:
So... if you're willing, would you appear 
on another TV special with us?! I know for 
certain you'll become super popular!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: E... Eeeeeh~?! T-T-That's... umm... ghk!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: P-P-Please let me think about it~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Producer
text_block_list.text: Huh... Doto-san? Doto-saaaan!!

Even after becoming the Spicy King, the 
moment she stepped off stage, Meisho Doto 
went right back to her shy, bashful self!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: —Great job, Doto-chan! You did it~~!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Producer
text_block_list.text:
Thank you... Doto-san! How can I ever 
repay you?!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Producer
text_block_list.text:
Especially that one part! That was the 
coolest catchphrase ever!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Producer
text_block_list.text:
—"I, <chrname>, the incarnation of the Ghost 
Pepper"~~!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
—H-Huh...?! That was... just something 
that slipped out on impulse in the heat of 
the moment... U-U-Umm~~?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: ...P-P-P-Please forget about that~~~!!

And so Meisho Doto became the Spicy 
King—or rather, the incarnation of the 
Ghost Pepper. She delivered both courage 
and dreams right to living rooms across 
the nation!
